patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Adobe Marketo Engage documents a broader use-case set; Livestorm is narrower/specialist.

Frame: General-purpose vs specialist — Adobe Marketo Engage documents a broader use-case set; Livestorm is narrower/specialist.. Choose Livestorm only if your buying job matches “Browser-based webinar and virtual events platform for marketing teams.” rather than Adobe Marketo Engage's shape. Choose Adobe Marketo Engage only if your buying job matches “Enterprise B2B marketing automation platform (Adobe Marketo Engage) — custom quote; CRM se” rather than Livestorm's shape. Workflow advantage: Livestorm leans multichannel-campaigns, creator-marketing; Adobe Marketo Engage leans marketing-automation, lead-nurturing. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Adobe Marketo Engage documents a broader use-case set; Livestorm is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: Livestorm is Browser-based webinar and virtual events platform for marketing teams.; Adobe Marketo Engage is Enterprise B2B marketing automation platform (Adobe Marketo Engage) — custom quote; CRM secondary..
- Company-size focus: Livestorm (small-business, mid-market) vs Adobe Marketo Engage (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Livestorm-leaning multichannel-campaigns, creator-marketing vs Adobe Marketo Engage-leaning marketing-automation, lead-nurturing, analytics.
- Researched limits: Livestorm — Pricing is attendee-credit based (EUR), not a simple flat SaaS ladder; Adobe Marketo Engage — Custom quote only — no public list-price transparency.

Limitations — Livestorm: Pricing is attendee-credit based (EUR), not a simple flat SaaS ladder; Pro caps session length at 4 hours (12 on Enterprise); Adobe Marketo Engage: Custom quote only — no public list-price transparency; Implementation/ops overhead is enterprise-grade.

Poor-fit cases: Livestorm is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pricing is attendee-credit based (EUR), not a simple flat SaaS ladder · Adobe Marketo Engage is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Custom quote only — no public list-price transparency · Avoid Livestorm if you actually need Adobe Marketo Engage's motion (Enterprise B2B marketing automation platform (Adobe Marketo Engage) — custom quo)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
